C-ROLLBACK-STORE-BUILD-GUARD.Summary: Compile the actual app-store feature without including the desktop Windows rollback flow or its desktop-only caller, while retaining the pinned-key exclusion and inert Store commands.

Goals.R-1: Match restore_windows_flow and restore_inner to their documented desktop-only ownership with cfg(not(feature = "app-store")). Keep both function bodies and every desktop call route unchanged.
Goals.R-2: Keep pinned_pubkey_b64 excluded from app-store and all four Store command stubs inert. Preserve existing tests, verification, signature checks and mutation order.

Constraints.Constraint: Additional prerequisite discovered during TECH:F-004 native sandbox acceptance; original 77-record denominator unchanged. Link updater rollback groups without declaring any existing open updater finding fixed.

Observed scope is src-tauri/src/m068_rollback.rs only: two cfg guards, file-local ownership/change summary, and a new feature-specific stub regression. No function-body, signature, trust-anchor, key, networking, signing-boundary, configuration, entitlement, dependency, version or release change.
The root integrator owns durable M-068/V-M-068 apply and delivery. This approved spec/plan uses the owner's delegated technical authority, not a fabricated answer to an old question.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No updater transport remedy, signing architecture, Store packaging, production certificate/profile access, native sandbox acceptance claim or rollback refactor.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Reproduce the full-source app-store E0425 referencing pinned_pubkey_b64, then compile that same feature successfully with the helper still excluded. The additional restore_inner guard prevents its non-macOS branch from referencing an excluded Windows flow.

Actual feature-specific tests call all four Store command stubs: prepare/restore return the Store-managed error; status has no available version; outcome is null. Existing desktop rollback suites remain enabled and pass with their bodies unchanged.

Record source hashes and exact compiled test-artifact identity/digests/PIDs before test input; clean owned executables after every run. Root performs final integrity, review, apply/archive, ordinary delivery and Collecting accounting. Native bookmark sandbox acceptance remains separate until demonstrated.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --offline --no-default-features --features app-store --bin mark m068_rollback::rollback_store_stubs
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Failing-first actual app-store compile, successful same-feature compile and inert-stub execution, unchanged desktop rollback regression results. No sandbox/signing/owner acceptance inferred.
